description:
FILED s540e (Opus 5.5, 2026-11-15) while building #4989 (dclone copies directly).  Code sha 75904a35.  Probes: scratch/s540e/probe/dclone.pl + deep.pl in the s540e worktree (perl vs `git archive 75904a35` vs tree).  dclone on the s540e tree keeps EVERY one of these answers (the direct copy declines into the format path or reproduces it), so this task is the format path's.

1. TRAILING HOLES: `my @a = (1); $#a = 3; dclone(\@a)` -- perl ARRAY[1,HOLE,HOLE,HOLE] (length 4), PCL [1] (length 1).  The reader (`_r_item` SX_ARRAY) stores only the non-hole slots; perl's retrieve_array extends to the stored length.  Fix: set the length before the loop; the direct copy (builtin::deep_copy) sizes its container the same way today (to the last existing slot) and changes with it.
2. WEAK: `$w->{w} = $w->{t}; weaken($w->{w}); dclone($w)` -- perl's copy isweak, PCL strong.  Storable writes SX_WEAKREF; the shim's _w_ref never does and the reader ignores it.
3. HOOKS: a class with STORABLE_freeze -- perl calls STORABLE_freeze($obj, 1) and STORABLE_thaw($new, 1, $serialized, @refs) for dclone (probe: thawed => "frz:1:clone/clone"); PCL dies "Storable (PCL): the STORABLE_freeze hook of class Hooked is not implemented" (docs/not-supported.md).  For dclone the direct walk could call the hooks itself; freeze/thaw need SX_HOOK both ways.
4. V-STRING: `dclone(\v1.2.3)` -- perl reftype VSTRING; PCL a ref blessed into "VSTRING" holding "".
5. DEPTH, a CRASH: perl dies TRAPPABLY "Max. recursion depth with nested structures exceeded" past $Storable::recursion_limit (512: an array chain of 400 copies, 520 dies) / $Storable::recursion_limit_hash (256: a hash chain of 400 dies).  PCL copies a 1,000-deep chain and at 5,000 the process dies "Binding stack exhausted" (unhandled, eval does not trap it).  The shim declares both limits and never reads them (its own counter is 10,000).  Fix: enforce the two limits where perl does (store_array / store_hash nesting); builtin::deep_copy declines past 1,000 levels into the format path, so it inherits the fix.  Measure perl's exact boundary first (binary search on the chain length).

BAR: each row probed perl -> base -> tree; guard rows in Pl/t/storable-shim-01.t; docs/not-supported.md "Storable" updated.
subject: PRE-EXISTING (s540e, probed): Storable's format path (freeze/thaw, and dclone through it) diverges from perl's Storable 3.32 in five ways -- trailing array holes dropped, a weak reference copied strong, STORABLE_freeze/thaw hooks die (not implemented), a v-string ref comes back as a VSTRING-blessed scalar, and a structure nested past ~1,000 levels CRASHES the process (perl dies trappably at 512 / 256)
